status: FROZEN before any evolution/validation/test result exists; changing any field below requires a NEW experiment version with rationale (old leaderboard kept)
nature: hypothetical synthetic worlds; not forecasts of 2026-2031; not real-market evidence; shares one simulator across splits
candidate_status_ceiling: RESEARCH_CANDIDATE (does not replace Kim, change admission, or become a paper/live trader)

world.note: far-future label so no world resembles a forecast of a real year
world.eval_sessions: as given by the synthetic NYSE-style calendar (approx 1,255-1,260)
world.warmup_rule: >= longest permitted lookback across supported schemas: trend family MAX_LEGAL_PRICE_BARS=379 (momentum_slow max 378), D family regime_window max 250 -> 251 bars; 400 chosen; asserted in code

splits.source_block_pools: development-lane quarter-blocks (63 sessions) assigned to train/validation/test pools 50/25/25, stratified by volatility regime, so no historical block feeds two splits
splits.held_out_variation: validation and sealed-test worlds use different event-severity ranges and regime-transition parameters than training (see generator config); sealed worlds are not generated or opened until the nominee passes validation

execution_reference.decision: daily, at session close, using only information available then
execution_reference.slippage_note: slippage allowance already represents typical spread/impact; modeled half-spread enters only as max(allowance, half_spread) so it is never added on top
execution_reference.cash: no borrowing; buys limited to available cash minus reserved buys and fees; no credit for unfilled sells; unaffordable gap fills are reduced to the affordable quantity and the reduction is logged
execution_reference.order_sequence: sells fill before buys within a session
execution_reference.volume_limit: fills capped at a fixed share of session volume with deferral (parameters in generator config)
execution_reference.stress_overlays: gaps, partial fills, rejections, stale/missing feeds, halts, outages are SEPARATE overlays, not part of the reference case

cash_yield: world policy-rate path accrues daily on cash for every portfolio (strategies, passive18, cash reference) identically

overlay.scaling: weights scaled so gross <= 0.18 (same as the accepted replay harness 18% overlay arm)
overlay.native_exposure: separate sensitivity for references only; never mixed into the primary score

lineage_semantics.halt: accepted external drawdown halt s6a_final.DRAWDOWN_HALT (12%) latches and liquidates, as in the accepted evaluator
lineage_semantics.cadence: lineage rebalance_sessions / rebalance_every_n_sessions anchored at step 0 = first evaluation session, no catch-up
lineage_semantics.decision_inputs: adjusted series built ONLY from corporate actions effective on or before the decision date

passive18.weights: equal weight 2.25% each of eight instruments (18% gross)
passive18.rebalance: monthly (first session of each calendar month; initial purchase at step 0)

controls.cash: no trading; earns the same cash yield

supported_mutation_schemas: TREND (s5a_config.mutate_genome, frozen S5A mutation protocol; the champion's family)
evolution.unsupported_in_v1: lineages B,C,E,F,G (state semantics / evaluator parity not established in this gym)
evolution.population_composition: 3 immutable references + 29 distinct bounded mutations (13 TREND from the champion lineage, 16 D from Sam / D-primary-rank3 lineage) in generation 0
evolution.crossover: none (no cross-family crossover; schema-compatible behaviour not demonstrated)
evolution.parent_selection: 4-way tournament over (eligible first, then primary score) with seeded RNG
evolution.survivors_per_generation: all 3 references + top 8 eligible by primary ordering; remaining slots filled by new children
evolution.mutation_retries: <= 4 seeded attempts per child; if the generation cannot be filled with valid distinct children it STOPS (no looping)

primary_objective.name: lower_quartile_excess_vs_passive18
primary_objective.definition: 25th percentile (linear interpolation between order statistics, position 0.25*(n-1), n=12 training worlds) of [annualized net return of genome - annualized net return of passive18] per world
primary_objective.annualized_net_return: (final_equity / start_equity) ** (252 / evaluation_sessions) - 1, equity = cash + receivables + shares x raw close

eligibility.scope: every training world; every validation world for the nominee; every sealed world for the nominee
eligibility.note: the 8% is a synthetic research criterion, NOT acceptance of the proposed live pilot halt
eligibility.ineligible_candidates: reported, never silently dropped; 'no qualifying winner' is a valid outcome

tie_breaks: lower turnover (traded notional / start equity, mean over worlds)
secondary_reporting: median/worst max drawdown and recovery duration (sessions)
Sharpe and Sortino with the world's cash rate as the risk-free rate

nomination_and_validation.nominee: the best ELIGIBLE genome of the final generation by (primary score, tie-breaks); if none eligible the outcome is 'no qualifying winner' and validation/test are NOT run
nomination_and_validation.validation_run: exactly once, frozen nominee + references, on the 6 validation worlds
nomination_and_validation.validation_pass_rule: nominee eligible in all 6 validation worlds AND validation lower-quartile excess vs passive18 (same definition, n=6, position 1.25) > 0
nomination_and_validation.sealed_test: run ONLY if validation passes; once; nominee + references; pass = eligible in all 6 sealed worlds AND lower-quartile excess > 0; no detailed test outcome feeds back into this run

budgets.memory_cap_basis: 25% of free RAM measured in preflight (3,272 MiB available -> 818 MiB) which is below the 2 GiB ceiling
budgets.output_cap_basis: below min(2 GiB, 25% of 26 GB free disk)
budgets.network: denied for simulation/evolution runs (private network namespace)
budgets.on_exhaustion: halt cleanly at a generation boundary; no extra seeds; report completed work

determinism: all randomness from random.Random(seed).random() only, via a local RNG helper; outputs rounded to fixed decimals before hashing; regenerated worlds must hash identically on HOST and EC2
metric_change_policy: any change creates a new immutable experiment version; every reference and candidate is re-evaluated on training data; the old leaderboard is kept; the sealed test set is never used to tune

amendments.results_existing_at_amendment: none (no genome has been evaluated on any world; only generator engineering worlds exist)
changes: evolution.supported_mutation_schemas gains TREND; unsupported list loses the champion family
amendments.reason: Discovered while wiring genomes: the champion's trend family DOES have a frozen schema and mutation protocol (s5a_config.validate_genome / mutate_genome), contrary to my earlier statement, and its longest permitted lookback is 379 bars, which exceeds the originally frozen 320-session warm-up. The frozen rule 'warm-up >= longest permitted lookback' therefore required the larger number.
